description:
## What

Extract §6.1.4(g) NameConstraints state update (lines 2550–2657) into `pub(crate) fn update_name_constraints_state(cert: &Certificate, state: &mut WorkingState) -> Result<()>`.

## Risk

HIGH.

## nc_constrained_types invariant (PKIX-als9 design §7)

> "nc_constrained_types invariant (2067–2072): bits are ORed in, never cleared. H10 must preserve this. NO test fails if a helper clears a bit — type-bit accounting is an internal invariant, not PKITS-checked. HIGH CONCERN."

Reviewer must explicitly verify that H10 only ORs bits into `nc_constrained_types`, never clears them.

## PKITS coverage gap (design §5)

> "NC empty-intersection via nc_constrained_types — DN/RFC822/DNS/URI tested; IPAddress and OtherName thin."

## Self-issued exemption

§6.1.3(b) NC subject-name check skip on self-issued — PKITS §4.5 self-issued fixtures (PKIX-77cl) cover the structural cases. §4.13 self-issued tests cover the NC-skip semantics.

## Dependencies

- H9 (sequenced).

## Acceptance

- New helper.
- Code-review checkpoint: nc_constrained_types bits ORed only, never cleared.
- All PKITS NC tests (§4.13) pass.
- §4.5 tests pass.
- clippy clean.
- No behaviour change.
